description: Mention popup (triggered by @ or [[) with People, Pages, and Date tabs (or pages only), featuring a search input, results list, and keyboard navigation, raising the selected item as a type, id, and display text.

parameters.name: OnClosed
parameters.description: Raised when the user dismisses the menu.

parameters.name: OnItemSelected
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string Type, string Id, string Display)>
parameters.description: Raised when the user picks a mention. Args: (type, id, displayText).

parameters.name: PagesOnly
parameters.description: When true only the Pages tab is shown (triggered by '[[').
